$comment: Outstanding spacing-check breaches on pages this wave did not own.
Every entry names a page, a selector fragment that matches the finding,
and a reason. spacing-check.mjs FAILS on a finding no entry covers, and
FAILS on an entry that no longer covers a finding — so the list cannot
grow stale and cannot be used to bury a page. Delete the entry when the
page is fixed; the check then fails until you do.
Most of the rest are the same defect: a column of cards with no declared
gap, so two bordered blocks share an edge. The fix is one word per page —
put `vstack` on the column wrapper, or give the dead `.grid` class a
`display` so the inline grid-template-columns it already declares applies.
family-create is the odd one: stacked role=checkbox cards with no gap and
no hairline is not a column-of-cards defect.
